You are purchasing a "VTG Tobacciana Lot Meerschaum Lucky Strike Tin Estate Pipes German Smoker +" in "Used" condition.
Fun mixed lot of vintage smoking and decor pieces, perfect for collectors or for adding character to a man cave, bar, or display shelf. You’ll receive everything shown, including: - 3 classic wooden smoking pipes with great aged patina - 2 ashtrays: one carved "Aloha Hawaii" souvenir style and one green sailor-themed plate-style ashtray/dish - 1 white ceramic round ashtray - 1 Lucky Strike flat fifties style cigarette tin / case - 1 metal table lighter - 1 small metal knife with rectangular handle (butter or spreader style) - 1 ornate metal candle holder with leaf-like base - 1 charming wooden German figure with beard and green coat. This is a character-filled assortment with a nostalgic vibe—ideal if you love vintage tobacco-related items, rustic decor, or unique conversation pieces. Great as a starter collection or to break up and use in different rooms or displays.
